posts.name: Princess Rose Ivory
posts.cooked:
From my experience, I must agree about safe zones in PvP. Guild Wars (Reforged) is more story based than PvP. All the real PvP happens in Factions the second game. When they made Ascalon, in Prophecies the very first game, you start a new character in pre-searing Ascalon. You can live there forever, it is just the tutorial. I have a level 20 character there to this very day.

The big wigs at Fenris, believe this will keep new people in the game long enough to learn to like it. However they say there is little to do there, nothing worth your time, and no shooting allowed. Vets can and will get banned for over mining the region, I am not even sure I understand the amount of ore you need to scamper off with to qualify.

If I weren’t invited here by a friend playing this game, I wouldn’t be here at all. I do enjoy PvP games, but the best PvP is still ( my opinion ) Guild Wars: Factions. I still PvP there on the weekends. Second best is Black Desert, but I am not a big fan of going red and getting sent to jail. However these games are not PvP first and foremost like here in Eve Online.

By adding this new region, they killed the one thing that made them stand out above the rest. What is that? Space is very dangerous, you will die here… probably on the first day. ← If they use that as their tag line, I want a royalty! Oh but wait, they can’t use that anymore. This is Eve Online where you get put in a safe space, where no one can hurt you. You are encouraged to leave after 30 days, or you can stay here and do nothing.

This new region will change nothing for me. Fenris hopes it will promote player growth. If I jump into a new game and have to play in a 30 day tutorial zone… well I suspect there will be a lot of dead accounts in there after the first 2 or 3 weeks. I really wish I could be more positive and uplifting about their new region, but to me it sounds like “KEEP OUT” signs should be posted for the vets on this side of the gate.

Have fun!
